name: Kemono Hara
source:
Je*sica has been put under an evil curse, and she is at her wits' end. Then she is captured by a monster, who violates her and fills her womb with its semen.
Now that she is not only cursed but also pregnant, what will become of her?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032591.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Je*sica身中邪恶诅咒，束手无策。随后她被一只怪物抓住并遭到侵犯，子宫里也被灌满了它的精液。
如今她不仅身负诅咒，还怀上了怪物的孩子，等待她的将会是什么？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032591.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
